entities.name: Livonian War & Partition of Latvia
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Ivan the Terrible's invasion of Livonia, the dissolution of the Livonian Confederation, and the partition of Latvian territory. Courland became a duchy under Polish-Lithuanian suzerainty under the last Master, Gotthard Kettler.
